```{r, message=FALSE}
# Library Import
library(dplyr)
library(biomaRt)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggfortify)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(grid)

setwd("~/Desktop/Tese/R/Transcriptomic analysis")
```


# 1. Data Import

```{r import, message=FALSE}

# Data import
fpkm <- read.table("GSE263058_FPKM.all.txt.gz",
                   header = TRUE, sep = "\t")


# Create working copy
fpkm_gse263058 <- fpkm

# Set gene_name as rownames
rownames(fpkm_gse263058) <- fpkm_gse263058$gene_name
fpkm_gse263058 <- fpkm_gse263058[, -1]

# Select only iPSC and 2D-iEC samples
fpkm_gse263058 <- fpkm_gse263058[, c("hiPS.BJ273.rep1", "hiPS.BJ273.rep2", "hiPS.BJ273.rep3",
                                      "iETV2.iEC.rep1",  "iETV2.iEC.rep2",  "iETV2.iEC.rep3")]

# Rename columns
colnames(fpkm_gse263058) <- c("iPSC_1", "iPSC_2", "iPSC_3",
                               "iEC_1",  "iEC_2",  "iEC_3")

# Confirm
dim(fpkm_gse263058)
head(fpkm_gse263058[, 1:4])
```

# 2. Filtration

```{r filtration}

# Define group labels
group_labels_gse263058 <- c("iPSC", "iPSC", "iPSC",
                             "iEC",  "iEC",  "iEC")

# Define metadata
metadata_gse263058 <- data.frame(
  sample = colnames(fpkm_gse263058),
  group  = group_labels_gse263058
)

# Require FPKM > 1 in at least 50% of samples within at least one group
min_present <- function(n) ceiling(n * 0.5)

groups <- unique(metadata_gse263058$group)

keep_by_group <- lapply(groups, function(g) {
  cols_g <- metadata_gse263058$sample[metadata_gse263058$group == g]
  n_g    <- length(cols_g)
  rowSums(fpkm_gse263058[, cols_g, drop = FALSE] > 1) >= min_present(n_g)
})

keep          <- Reduce(`|`, keep_by_group)
fpkm_filtered <- fpkm_gse263058[keep, ]

dim(fpkm_filtered)

```
# 3. Transformation

```{r Transformation}

# LOG2 TRANSFORMATION
expr_log_gse263058 <- log2(fpkm_filtered + 1)

# CANONICAL MARKER CHECK
pluripotency         <- c("POU5F1", "SOX2", "KLF4", "MYC")
mesoderm_induction   <- c("TBXT", "MIXL1", "EOMES", "ETV2", "KDR", "CD34")
endothelial_identity <- c("PECAM1", "CDH5", "VWF", "NOS3", "SOX17", "ERG")

canonical_genes <- c(pluripotency, mesoderm_induction, endothelial_identity)

# Genes absent from dataset entirely
genes_not_in_data <- canonical_genes[!canonical_genes %in% rownames(fpkm_gse263058)]

# Genes removed by filtration
genes_filtered_out <- canonical_genes[canonical_genes %in% rownames(fpkm_gse263058) &
                                      !canonical_genes %in% rownames(expr_log_gse263058)]

# Genes available for analysis
genes_use_gse263058 <- canonical_genes[canonical_genes %in% rownames(expr_log_gse263058)]

cat("=== CANONICAL MARKER CHECK ===\n")
cat("Used in analysis:      ", paste(genes_use_gse263058,          collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Absent from dataset:   ", paste(genes_not_in_data,  collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Removed by filtration: ", paste(genes_filtered_out, collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

# 4. PCA 
```{r PCA}

# Prepare data matrix for PCA
dfforpca_gse263058 <- t(expr_log_gse263058)
dfforpca_gse263058 <- as.data.frame(dfforpca_gse263058)
dfforpca_gse263058$group_labels <- group_labels_gse263058

# Specify factor levels in trajectory order
dfforpca_gse263058$group_labels <- factor(dfforpca_gse263058$group_labels,
                                           levels = c("iPSC", "iEC"))

# Run PCA
numcol_gse263058  <- 1:(ncol(dfforpca_gse263058) - 1)
pca_res_gse263058 <- prcomp(dfforpca_gse263058[, numcol_gse263058], scale = FALSE)

# PCA plot
p_gse263058 <- autoplot(
  pca_res_gse263058,
  data   = dfforpca_gse263058,
  x      = 1,
  y      = 2,
  colour = "group_labels",
  size   = 8,
  alpha  = 0.7
) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_colour_manual(
    name   = "Cell Type",
    values = c("iPSC" = "lightblue",
               "iEC"  = "lightgreen")
  ) +
  ggtitle("PCA Plot - GSE263058") +
  theme(
    plot.title       = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.line        = element_line(colour = "black"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border     = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank()
  )

p_gse263058

# Top contributing genes per PC
contribs1_gse263058 <- pca_res_gse263058$rotation[, 1]
contribs2_gse263058 <- pca_res_gse263058$rotation[, 2]

(pos1genes_gse263058 <- sort(contribs1_gse263058, decreasing = TRUE)[1:10])
(neg1genes_gse263058 <- sort(contribs1_gse263058, decreasing = FALSE)[1:10])
(pos2genes_gse263058 <- sort(contribs2_gse263058, decreasing = TRUE)[1:10])
(neg2genes_gse263058 <- sort(contribs2_gse263058, decreasing = FALSE)[1:10])

```

# 5. Heatmap

```{r heatmap, fig.width=12, fig.height=6.5}

# Create stage mapping
stage_map_gse263058 <- c(
  setNames(rep("Pluripotency",         length(pluripotency)),         pluripotency),
  setNames(rep("Mesoderm induction",   length(mesoderm_induction)),   mesoderm_induction),
  setNames(rep("Endothelial identity", length(endothelial_identity)), endothelial_identity)
)

row_stage_gse263058 <- factor(
  stage_map_gse263058[genes_use_gse263058],
  levels = c("Pluripotency", "Mesoderm induction", "Endothelial identity")
)

# Subset and row-scale expression matrix
mat   <- as.matrix(expr_log_gse263058[genes_use_gse263058, , drop = FALSE])
mat_z_gse263058 <- t(scale(t(mat)))
mat_z_gse263058[is.na(mat_z_gse263058)] <- 0

# Column groups
col_group_gse263058 <- factor(
  c(rep("iPSC", 3), rep("iEC", 3)),
  levels = c("iPSC", "iEC")
)

# Heatmap colour scale
col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  c(-2, 0, 2),
  c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B")
)

# Top annotation
top_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Group = anno_block(
    gp        = gpar(fill = "grey95", col = "grey70"),
    labels    = c("iPSC", "iEC"),
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11, fontface = "bold", col = "black")
  ),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE,
  height = unit(7, "mm")
)

# Left annotation
left_ha <- rowAnnotation(
  Stage = anno_block(
    gp         = gpar(fill = "grey95", col = "grey70"),
    labels     = c("Pluripotency", "Mesoderm induction", "Endothelial identity"),
    labels_gp  = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold", col = "black"),
    labels_rot = 0
  ),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE,
  width = unit(37, "mm")
)

# Draw heatmap
ht <- Heatmap(
  mat_z_gse263058,
  name = "Z-score\nexpression",
  col  = col_fun,

  cluster_rows    = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,

  row_split    = row_stage_gse263058,
  column_split = col_group_gse263058,

  top_annotation  = top_ha,
  left_annotation = left_ha,

  column_title = NULL,
  row_title    = NULL,

  show_row_names    = TRUE,
  row_names_side    = "right",
  row_names_gp      = gpar(fontsize = 10),

  show_column_names = TRUE,
  column_names_rot  = 90,
  column_names_gp   = gpar(fontsize = 10),

  show_row_dend    = FALSE,
  show_column_dend = FALSE,

  row_gap    = unit(3, "mm"),
  column_gap = unit(3, "mm"),

  rect_gp = gpar(col = "grey70", lwd = 0.6),
  border  = TRUE,

  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title  = "Z-score\nexpression",
    at     = c(-2, -1, 0, 1, 2),
    labels = c("-2", "-1", "0", "1", "2")
  )
)

draw(
  ht,
  heatmap_legend_side = "right",
  column_title        = "Canonical marker expression across iPSC and iEC stages - GSE263058",
  column_title_side   = "top",
  column_title_gp     = gpar(fontsize = 14, fontface = "bold"),
  padding             = unit(c(4, 2, 2, 20), "mm")
)
```
# 6. Export
```{r export}
library(writexl)

# Create output directory
dir.create("results/GSE263058", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# 1. Gene availability table
gene_availability <- data.frame(
  gene          = canonical_genes,
  in_dataset    = canonical_genes %in% rownames(fpkm_gse263058),
  after_filter  = canonical_genes %in% rownames(expr_log_gse263058),
  status        = ifelse(
    !canonical_genes %in% rownames(fpkm_gse263058), "Absent from dataset",
    ifelse(!canonical_genes %in% rownames(expr_log_gse263058), "Removed by filtration", "Used")
  )
)

write.csv(gene_availability,
          "results/GSE263058/gene_availability.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)

# 2. PCA plot
pdf("results/GSE263058/pca_plot.pdf", width = 7, height = 6)
print(p_gse263058)
dev.off()

# 3. Heatmap
pdf("results/GSE263058/heatmap.pdf", width = 12, height = 6.5)
draw(
  ht,
  heatmap_legend_side = "right",
  column_title        = "Canonical marker expression across iPSC and iEC stages - GSE263058",
  column_title_side   = "top",
  column_title_gp     = gpar(fontsize = 14, fontface = "bold"),
  padding             = unit(c(4, 2, 2, 20), "mm")
)
dev.off()

write.csv(mat_z_gse263058, "results/GSE263058/mat_z.csv")
```
